title: Frozen-hero safety release never fires: player.gd tests the Callable GameMenu.story_busy instead of calling it
repro: player.gd:632 `... and not GameMenu.story_busy:` - story_busy is a static func(tree); without () it is a Callable, which is truthy, so `not GameMenu.story_busy` is always false (probe tools/probe_c7_13_callable.gd prints false). The c6_18 FREEZE_SAFETY (12 s) release therefore never runs; any beat/scene that leaves player.frozen=true with nothing on screen is a permanent softlock again.
fix: Call it: `not GameMenu.story_busy(get_tree())`. Note story_busy itself returns true whenever story_pending is set and the player is frozen, so a beat that hangs mid-play (await never resolves) would still block the release; better gate on a real 'beat running' signal, e.g. a static Story.playing counter set in play() and cleared in a finally-style path, or treat story_pending as busy only while Dialogue is active. Add an assert to softlock_test.gd: freeze the player with no dialogue/story_pending, advance >12 s game time, expect frozen=false.

title: 12 painted story panels are sliced but never shown: gangster opening, both finales and the penguin ch4/5 beats have no pic
repro: Only cut_star (farm intro), cut_cattopia, cut_chase, cut_campfire, cut_drill_* and cut_war_table are referenced anywhere. art/gen/ui has cut_rain_road, cut_old_dog, cut_letter, cut_tower_doors, cut_president_chair, cut_stone_break, cut_two_crystals, cut_quiet_mountain, cut_crystal_prison, cut_uphill_stream, cut_merkitty_ring, cut_prismatica_top (Prompts 20/21/w271, made for these scenes) and no line in data/story.json, data/campaign_story.json or any script uses them. The gangster arc has zero story panels; neither finale shows one.
fix: Add "pic" (and "pic": "none" on the line after where the panel should drop) to: farm.gd _intro_gangsters first line -> cut_rain_road; g5_doors_letter first line -> cut_letter, g5_doors_force/kept first line -> cut_tower_doors; g5_president first line -> cut_president_chair; g5_win last narration -> cut_stone_break; p4_prison -> cut_crystal_prison; p4_merkitties -> cut_merkitty_ring; p3_mountain or p3_babies -> cut_uphill_stream; p5_spire -> cut_prismatica_top; p5_win -> cut_two_crystals; p5_epilogue -> cut_quiet_mountain then cut_old_dog (Biscuit comes home). story.json is hand-edited. A check (story_test.gd) that every ui/cut_* in the manifest is referenced would keep this from recurring.

title: B answers a permanent story decision: g4_shop2's last option 'Leave her be.' reads as a way out
repro: Gangster arc, after shop_1 + boss_neon talk to Deuce (g4_shop2, key shop_2). Pressing B on the choice: Dialogue._process_input checks is_way_out(last, menu=false); WAY_OUT has 'leave', so 'Leave her be.' is picked and shop_2_decided/shop_2_refused are stored for good (shop 3 never offered). The rule is that B never answers a stored story decision for the player.
fix: Reword the option so it doesn't start with a WAY_OUT word (e.g. 'Let her keep it.') in data/story.json (hand-edited), and/or make keyed choices only take B when the effects for that pick unflag the beat (a true defer). A check in story_test/softlock_test: no keyed choice whose last option is a way out unless that option's effects_by_choice unflags the beat.

title: quest_done beats are edge-triggered only: if the moment is missed they never fire, and some carry required flags (catship_done, crew_vic/crew_val)
repro: Story.on_quest_done is called once, from GameState.complete_quest, and only when current_scene is a GameMap. Its waiting loop returns for good if the map leaves the tree before the beat plays (it waits while Dialogue is active or the player is frozen, e.g. a pass-out/faint right after a boss kill, or a scene change). The quest is already saved as done, so nothing ever re-offers the beat; restore_spawns and tick only handle scene/area triggers. Same if the app is killed between complete_quest and the beat (story_pending isn't set yet). Losses: p2_spark sets catship_done, which quests.json wastes_gate needs (penguin ch2->3 stalls; p3_mountain/p3_babies also need it); g4_twins sets crew_vic/crew_val (Ops 'arcade' op waits on crew_vic); p1_grump_truth/p2_locket/p3_knight_done/p4_tele/g1_man/g4_flame carry the chapter's main-quest hand-offs and flags.
fix: Make quest_done beats level-triggered as a backstop: in Story.tick (already runs twice a second when nothing is on screen), after the scene/area loop, look for a beat with trigger.quest_done whose quest GameState.quest_done(q) is true and _ready_beat() passes, and play it (one per tick). Keep on_quest_done for the immediate play. Add to story_test.gd: mark 'spark' done in run without the event, load the farm, tick ~2 s game time, expect st_p2_spark and catship_done.

title: Story.play finishes a broken-off beat as if it played: beat effects run after a failed gate, and after a mid-beat scene change on the wrong map
repro: (1) _play_lines: when a choice gate fails (g2_deuce fee, g2_rosa crops, g4_dice, g4_doc) it erases st_<beat> and returns, but play() then still runs _apply(b.effects), _quests_now, erases story_pending and saves; harmless today only because those four beats have empty effects, and a gate inside a nested branch returns only from the inner call, so the outer lines keep playing. (2) If m is freed during the lines, play() swaps to current_scene and applies the effects there: a 'spawn' list lands at the old map's cells on the new map and story_spawns records it under the new scene id; if a choice was interrupted, its effects_by_choice are skipped but the beat stays fired (st_ set, story_pending cleared), so e.g. a crew join is lost for good.
fix: Have _play_lines return a status (ok / gated / cut) and let play() stop on gated (no effects, flag stays erased) and on cut (leave st_ erased and story_pending unset so the beat can run again instead of applying effects to another map). Propagate the gated status out of nested branches.

title: Only the farm opening can be skipped: story beats (incl. replays after an app close) have no Skip
repro: begin_skippable is called only in farm._intro. Story.play never offers Skip, so long beats (g5_president 8 lines, p2_catkins/p2_spark/p3_babies/p4_prison 7, finales) must be tapped through, and a beat cut off by an app close replays from the start with no way to fast-forward (GameState load erases st_<story_pending>). Phone players re-watching a scene they already read is the usual case after a crash/kill.
fix: In Story.play wrap _play_lines with Dialogue.begin_skippable(m) / end_skippable() (only if the dialogue's _skip_owner is still m at the end, as farm._intro does). Choices still stop the skip, and lines that must show can carry "keep": true (e.g. the gate-fail toasts are toasts already; mark reward/instruction lines like p3_babies' Meow Pow Wow tip keep). Optionally only offer Skip when the beat was replayed (remember the id of a story_pending erased on load).
needs_tom: Should first-time story scenes be skippable too, or only replays?

title: Quest-done beats start under an open full-screen UI: p2_spark (the catship cutscene) plays hidden behind the Resonator's CraftScreen
repro: Penguin arc, spark quest: start a Refined Crystal at the Crystal Resonator, wait, open the station. CraftScreen._refresh -> Crafting.collect -> m.give -> _check_quests (deferred, runs while paused) -> complete_quest('spark') -> Story.on_quest_done. Its wait loop only checks Dialogue.active / player.frozen, not tree.paused or a modal, so Story.play starts at once: Dialogue (layer 8) opens under CraftScreen (layer 60). Probe tools/probe_c7_13_qdone.gd (layer-60 screen holding Hud.pause, then complete_quest('spark')) prints dialogue active=true, beat fired=true, under the screen. Taps/A on the craft screen also feed the hidden dialogue (it polls actions), so the 7-line cutscene with its 5 picture panels is skipped unseen; the same holds for any quest finished from a shop/chest/craft screen.
fix: In on_quest_done's wait loop also wait while m.get_tree().paused or Hud.modal_rect has area (any full-screen UI open), i.e. the same gate Story.tick uses; and in Story.play bail out (re-queue) if the tree is paused by something other than Dialogue. Add a case to story_test.gd mirroring the probe: expect the beat to wait until the screen closes.

title: No guard against two beats playing at once (tick's deferred play vs on_quest_done's loop)
repro: Story.tick checks Dialogue.active/frozen and then defers play via m.later (call_deferred); on_quest_done's loop resumes on process_frame and calls play directly. If a quest finishes on a map where an arrival/area beat is also ready (e.g. sky: p4_prison after boss_sky while a knight quest_done beat waits; moon: several p5_* arrival beats plus quest completions), both can pass their checks in the same frame. Story.play has no 'already playing' check, so the second beat's say() is appended to the first's queue and both awaits resolve on the same finished signal: lines interleave, a choice of one beat can be read by the other (d.last_choice), and the first play() unfreezes the player while the second is still mid-scene.
fix: Add static var Story._playing (bool/counter) set at the top of play() and cleared at the end; tick, on_morning, talk and the on_quest_done loop wait/skip while it is set (and set it before the m.later defer in tick so the window closes).

title: MENU (the Skip key) opens the game menu during the opening's fades: story_busy only knows Story beats
repro: New game, either arc. farm._intro_penguins/_intro_gangsters await hud.fade_out(0.6) + fade_in(0.8) between say() batches (farm.gd 1782-1789, 1838-1843). During those ~1.4 s Dialogue is inactive, the tree isn't paused and run has no story_pending, so GameMenu.story_busy() is false; pressing MENU (which the Skip hint teaches as 'skip') opens the full menu mid-intro over the black fade (Items/Map/Save & title all live, the fade tween paused under it). The same gap exists in any scripted scene that holds player.frozen without story_pending (region intros between lines, ArcIntro, CampaignGate drill lead-ins).
fix: Treat a skippable scene and a deliberately frozen player as busy: in GameMenu.story_busy return true when Dialogue.instance(tree).skippable, or when GameState.run lacks intro_done (opening still running). Better: let story_busy fall back to 'player.frozen and the hero was frozen by a scene' using a Story._playing/scene-owner flag, and keep the c6_18 freeze-safety release as the escape hatch.

title: p3_campfire (the mountain camp with cut_campfire) plays at the home bed / clinic, any morning after first seeing the mountain
repro: p3_campfire has trigger {sleep: true} with when mountain_seen+meow_taught+catship_done+quest commander. Story.on_morning runs from house.gd (and the clinic wake in hud.gd), so the scene 'That night, something follows you up from the valley... Big Jim... I brought camp gear... Marshmallows, shooting stars, an aurora' (panel cut_campfire) appears when you wake up in your farmhouse, possibly weeks after the last mountain visit; the sky_stair quest text sells it as 'a night's camp' on the mountain pass.
fix: Either give the mountain a camp spot (a 'camp' thing near the pass that sleeps the night there and calls Story.on_morning on the mountain map with a new trigger {"sleep": "mountain"}), or reword the first line so it reads as a memory/visit at home (e.g. 'Last night, by the farm gate, someone came down from the mountain path...'). story.json is hand-edited.
